description: (Na)₂LuAgCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a LuAgCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the LuAgCl₆ framework, Lu is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form LuCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AgCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Lu-Cl bond lengths are 2.56 Å. Ag is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form AgCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LuCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ag-Cl bond lengths are 2.70 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Lu and one Ag atom.
